text.en: This Notification may be cited as the Miscellaneous Offences (Public Pounds) Notification. [S 59/2021]
The places mentioned in the Schedule are appointed to be public pounds for the purposes of the Miscellaneous Offences Act. [S 59/2021]

heading.en: Authority to appoint other places to be pounds

text.en: Any Officer-in-Charge of Police Station is authorised to appoint other places to be pounds and the places so appointed are deemed to be public pounds for the purposes of the Miscellaneous Offences Act. [S 59/2021] Authority to appoint pound-keepers

Any Officer-in-Charge of Police Station is authorised to appoint pound-keepers to take charge and feed cattle impounded under the Miscellaneous Offences Act, and to pay to pound-keepers so appointed such fees as may be fixed by the Commissioner of Police. [S 59/2021] 6 CAP. 30, N 2 Miscellaneous Offences

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)
